rows.grounds: compound: japa (recitation) + ādibhiḥ (beginning-with/and-others), indicating ritual acts including japa
absolutive of hu (to offer into fire), referring to homa action
absolutive of kṛ (to do/make), indicating completion of ritual acts
compound: brahma (Brahman) + arpaṇa (dedication/offering) + āhuti (oblation), denoting oblation offered as dedication to Brahman
